title: cygnus-jet-utac v1.0.2: UTAC Analysis of Astrophysical Relativistic Jet Criticality
description: cygnus-jet-utac v1.0.2 applies UTAC (Universal Threshold Activation Criticality) to relativistic jet dynamics in Cygnus X-1 and analogous X-ray binary systems, with genuinely independent, RK4-integrated ODE dynamics and textbook-correct surrounding astrophysics (CAK stellar-wind law, relativistic jet kinematics, Keplerian orbit). The headline Gamma_jet calibration and its benchmark comparison against Prabu et al. 2026 are construction artifacts rather than independent validation (see efficiency.py and benchmark.py for the full caveat) -- CREP metrics and benchmark scoring should be read as internal-consistency checks on the model, not confirmed agreement with independent observations. Part of the GenesisAeon ecosystem (genesis-os). Dual-licensed: GPLv3-or-later (code) + CC BY 4.0 (documentation).
